'''Grand Admiral Tsung In The Hands of Confusion V.1''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Grand Admiral Tsung]]
* '''Published:''' 15 May 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Theme/Fun
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|SE-D-ralltiiroperations.gif|label=Ralltiir Operations}}
* '''Strategy:''' Ralltiir Operations
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 ROps Tsung DS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

May Sideous have mercy on your soul...

The published list has 54 cards.

== Strategy ==

Less Sd's than my usual decks but not bad nonetheless...

Deploy Ralltir, Prepared defenses, Secret Plans, Mob points, Battle Plans.

On first turn- deploy any sites in hand plus Spaceport Docking bay.

continue to deploy an Biker scout trooper plus any combat vehicles in hand. keep deploying non* imps as well as locations to Ralltir...
Keep them from space draining w/ battle plans and Ralltir Ops when flipped. Drain Constantly using your SD'd in space and your ground troops... use Mob points to deploy executor...

As soon as Ralltir Ops flipped deploy Kuat, so that Battle plans will not affect you if you lose in space, just keep and SD w/ some ties or pilots there.  If they attempt to make a move on the ground slaughter them...
